visual_argument: A scan is drawn as a slab of tinted acrylic that covers only the part of a glass lung it was ordered for, and where it overlaps the lung it can hold a gold bead nobody asked it to find. The bead moves from inside the scan to a flagged line, to a counted row where two of every three slabs are periwinkle, to a navigator's hand and along a counter to the people who decide, then the deck turns to one patient, her family and the reader's own scan.
build_risk: Frame 4 must make three transmissive glass lungs and acrylic slabs read as three distinct solids at 432 px under an orthographic camera, with the periwinkle against frosted code legible without a legend and no reading as a count of nodules.
distinct_from_recent: Nov 24 drew an aerial stitched subdivision with judged roofs. Nov 22 drew cutaway exam rooms, a stethoscope wall and studio benches. Nov 21 drew a tracked rover on rubble. None drew glass anatomy, acrylic scan fields, a chart cart, an age rule on limestone, a family under an oak or an empty CT room.
